definition.alternative: Broad state coverage without trust boundary prioritization yields equivalent inquiry efficiency.
assumptions: Agents possess a mechanism for quantifying uncertainty within their own trust boundaries.
Information gain provides a measurable proxy for reducing architectural unpredictability.
Trust boundaries act as constraints on permissible inquiry domains.
definition.falsification: Inquiry strategies prioritizing broad state coverage result in higher stability metrics than those targeting trust boundary uncertainty under identical budget constraints.

definition.uncertainty: The precise formalization linking information gain metrics to architectural trust boundaries requires continuous empirical calibration.
